paite: Joash in vaihawm apat tung in kum sagih a upa ahi; Jerusalem ah kum sawmli vai ahawm a; anu min Zibiah, Beer-sheba mi ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Joash / (2 Kum 12.1-16)
english: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah, of Beersheba.

paite: Joash in siampu Jehoiada damsung in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
english: Joash did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

paite: Jehoiada in amah zi nih aguan a, tapate leh tanute anei hi.
english: Jehoiada took for him two wives, and he became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai nung in Joash in TOUPA' inn bawlphat lungsim in anei hi.
english: After this, Joash intended to restore Yahweh’s house.

paite: Siampute leh Levite akaikhawm a, "Judate khuate ah hoh unla kum teng a na Pathian inn uh bawlphatna ding in Israel mi tengteng kiang ah sum-le-pai khonkhawm unla, zekai kei un," achi hi. Himahleh Levite akintat tuan kei uhi.
english: He gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, “Go out to the cities of Judah, and gather money to repair the house of your God from all Israel from year to year. See that you expedite this matter.” However the Levites didn’t do it right away.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n siampu lianpen Jehoiada asam a, akiang ah, "Bangziak a Levite TOUPA sikha Mosi leh Israel mipite seh theihsak a puanin a dia thoh bikhiah seh Judah mi leh Jerusalem mite thoh ding a phut lou na hia?
english: The king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said to him, “Why haven’t you required of the Levites to bring in the tax of Moses the servant of Yahweh, and of the assembly of Israel, out of Judah and out of Jerusalem, for the Tent of the Testimony?”

paite: Migilou nu Athaliah tapate'n lah Pathian inn ahihse khinta ua, huan, TOUPA' inn a thillat tengteng Baalte ape khin behlap lai uh," achi hi.
english: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up God’s house; and they also gave all the dedicated things of Yahweh’s house to the Baals.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n thu apia a, bawm abawl ua, TOUPA in kongpi polam ah akoih uhi.
english: So the king commanded, and they made a chest, and set it outside at the gate of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Gamdai a Pathian sikha Mosi in Israel mite hih ding a thoh bikhiah a seh TOUPA a ding a thoh ding in Judah gam tengteng leh Jerusalem ah thu athangsakta hi.
english: They made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in for Yahweh the tax that Moses the servant of God laid on Israel in the wilderness.

paite: Huchi in miliante leh mipite akipak ua, adangkate uh ahon la ua, akhon khit masiah uh bawm ah ahong koihkoih mai uhi.
english: All the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had filled it.

paite: Levite'n kumpipa upate kiang a bawm ahon tawi ua, dangka tampi a-om chih atheih un kumpipa laigelhmi leh siampu kumpipa seh upa in bawm a kipan abungkhia a, ala ua, amun ah akoih nawn uh. Huchibang in niteng in ahih ua, dangka tampi akholkhawmta uhi.
english: Whenever the chest was brought to the king’s officers by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king’s scribe and the chief priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to its place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.

paite: Kumpipa leh Jehoiada in TOUPA' inn nasem mite khut ah apia ua, TOUPA' inn bawlpha ding in suangsek mite, khutsiamte, TOUPA' inn bawlpha ding in sik leh dal a khutsiamte leng aguai hi.
english: The king and Jehoiada gave it to those who did the work of the service of Yahweh’s house. They hired masons and carpenters to restore Yahweh’s house, and also those who worked iron and bronze to repair Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huchi in nasem mite'n asem pan ua, asem hoih mahmah ua, Pathian inn angei bang geih in abawlhoih ua, adingkip nawnta hi.
english: So the workmen worked, and the work of repairing went forward in their hands. They set up God’s house as it was designed, and strengthened it.

paite: Azoh un dangka om lai teng kumpipa leh Jehoiada kiang ah ahon tawi ua, huai in TOUPA' inn a nasepna ding a tui-um belsuante, latna tui-um belsuan sikkeute leh dangkasik tui-um belsuante nangawn abawl uhi. Huchi in Jehoiada damsung in TOUPA' inn ah halmang thillat alan gige uhi.
english: When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, from which were made vessels for Yahweh’s house, even vessels with which to minister and to offer, including spoons and vessels of gold and silver. They offered burnt offerings in Yahweh’s house continually all the days of Jehoiada.

paite: Jehoiada bel upapi tekkun a dam in asita. Asih in kum za-le-sawmthum a upa ahi.
heading: Jehoiada Thiltup Hong Kilehbulh
english: But Jehoiada grew old and was full of days, and he died. He was one hundred thirty years old when he died.

paite: Huchi in Israelte lak ah Pathian tung ah leh a-inn tungtang a thil ahihhoih ziak in David khopi ah kumpipate lak ah avui uhi.
english: They buried him in David’s city among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, and toward God and his house.

paite: Jehoiada sih nung in Judah miliante ahong kuan ua, kumpipa kiang ah toukaina abawl ua, kumpipa'n athu uh ana pom hi.
english: Now after the death of Jehoiada, the princes of Judah came and bowed down to the king. Then the king listened to them.

paite: Himahleh apipute uh Pathian TOUPA' inn alehngatsan ua, Asherahte leh milimte nna asemta uh. Huchi in akhelhna uh ziak in Judate leh Jerusalem tung ah thangpaihna ahong tungta hi.
english: They abandoned the house of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and the idols, so wrath came on Judah and Jerusalem for this their guiltiness.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA kiang a pikik ding in akiang uah zawlneite asawl a, amohdante uh atheisak ua, himahleh abil uh adoh nuam kei uhi.
english: Yet he sent prophets to them to bring them again to Yahweh, and they testified against them; but they would not listen.

paite: Siampu Jehoiada tapa Zekariah tung ah Pathian kha ahong tung a, amah mipi tunglam ah adingh a, akiang uah, "Pathian in hichi in achi: Bangziak a na lamzan theihlouhna ding ua TOUPA' thupiakte bohsia na hi ua? TOUPA na lehngatsan ziak un ama'n leng nou hon lehngatsan ahi,” achi hi.
english: The Spirit of God came on Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest; and he stood above the people, and said to them, “God says, ‘Why do you disobey Yahweh’s commandments, so that you can’t prosper? Because you have forsaken Yahweh, he has also forsaken you.’”

paite: Huchi in amah asawmta ua, kumpipa thupiak in TOUPA' inn huangsung ah suang in adenglumta uhi.
english: They conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huchibang in kumpipa Joash in apa Jehoiada hehpihna theigige lou in atapa athatta hi. Asih kuan in, "TOUPA'N ahon ngaihtuah ding a, phu ahon laksak ding," achi hi.
english: Thus Joash the king didn’t remember the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but killed his son. When he died, he said, “May Yahweh look at it, and repay it.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum abei in Siria sepaihte'n ahong sual ua; Judah gam leh Jerusalem ah alut ua, amilian tengteng uh ahihmansak ua, Damaskas kumpipa kiang ah gallak tengteng akhak vek uhi.
heading: Joash Vaihawm Sung Leh Asihna
english: At the end of the year, the army of the Syrians came up against him. They came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all their plunder to the king of Damascus.

paite: Siria sepaihte bel tawmchik kia ahong kuan ua; apipute uh Pathian TOUPA alehngatsan ziak un TOUPA'N sepaih tampite akhut uah apia ahi. Huchibang in Joash tung ah gawtna atungsak uhi.
english: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men; and Yahweh delivered a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken Yahweh, the God of their fathers. So they executed judgment on Joash.

paite: Apaisan nung un, natna thupitak thuak in apaisan ua, amah mite ngei in siampu Jehoiada tapate sisan ziak in asawm ua, alupna a lum lai athat ua, asita hi. David khopi ah avui ua, himahleh kumpipate han ah aphum kei uhi.
english: When they had departed from him (for they left him seriously wounded), his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and killed him on his bed, and he died. They buried him in David’s city, but they didn’t bury him in the tombs of the kings.

paite: Hiaite amah sawm mite ahi uh: Ammon mi Simeath tapa Zabad leh Moab mi Shimrith tapa Jehozabad.
english: These are those who conspired against him: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonitess and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess.

paite: Huchi in atapate tung ah thute, atung a puakgiktak puaksak tungtang thute; Pathian in abawlhoiht tungtang thute, ngai dih Kumpite Tanchin gelhna bu ah gelh ahi. Huan asik in atapa Amaziah in vai ahawmta hi.
english: Now concerning his sons, the greatness of the burdens laid on him, and the rebuilding of God’s house, behold, they are written in the commentary of the book of the kings. Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
